newsitem.title: USA: Food Concepts says merger talks progress.
newsitem.headline: Food Concepts says merger talks progress.

text.p: Food Concepts Inc said Tuesday that it has made "significant progress" toward a merger with Colonial Coffee Roasters and said it expects a definitive agreement in the next few weeks.
Combined revenues of the two companies would more than double the existing sales of Food Concepts, the company said.
The planned merger would not only add over a million dollars in revenues to Food Concepts, but also would increase their roasting capacity three-fold, Food Concepts said.
